artifact.name: 17-audit-integrity
artifact.purpose: Audit the 17 research type partitions for parseability, pairing, determinism, source references, identifiers, vocabularies, counts, section coverage, and isolated-output compliance.

method.input_scope: knowledgegraph/research/types/00-*.json through knowledgegraph/research/types/16-*.json and matching Markdown files
checks: evidence, confidence, status, and ordering vocabulary comparison
section-presence comparison against the heterogeneous worker schemas
declared implementation, Ghidra, SPORE, database, and historical-artifact isolation

reference_policy.exact_paths: A path is a broken reference only when its base repository path is absent after removing a line or record locator.
reference_policy.logical_locators: A JSON pointer, fragment, compound source alias, or extensionless artifact name is not treated as a missing filesystem path.
reference_policy.runtime_sidecars: SQLite WAL and shared-memory sidecars are reported as environment-dependent state, not as missing research source artifacts.

parseability_and_pairing.finding: All 17 JSON files parse and all 17 expected Markdown counterparts exist.

determinism.finding: The artifacts are individually authored and stable, but they do not share one ordering contract. Top-level key order is inconsistent; several scalar arrays are authored rather than lexical, and the lexical-order claims in 03 and 15 do not describe the actual object order.
evidence: 15 complete_sections, limitations, and non_goals are not lexically sorted.

source_references.finding: Two stale exact source paths are present. Logical locators and compound source aliases were not counted as broken paths.

broken_references.resolution: Replace with knowledgegraph/research/global-campaign-2026/track-f-empire-economy.json or retain only as a historical alias.
Replace with knowledgegraph/research/track-b-function-accounting.json, or explicitly mark the triage path as a historical alias.

non_broken_but_noncanonical: 01, 11, and 16 contain extensionless self-references to their logical artifact names.
06 contains compound source aliases such as src/apps/CellInput.hpp/.cpp.
00 references absent SQLite WAL and shared-memory sidecars; these are environment-dependent runtime state, not committed source files.

identifiers.finding: Most repeated identifiers are valid foreign keys, but three identity namespaces need normalization.

true_or_ambiguous_collisions.detail: The triage and semantic-atlas snapshot records reuse the same id; the semantic-atlas record also omits sha256.
RW4 and RW4 section-class content records share one type_id. A record identity and a resource type key should be separate fields if both records are retained.
The same identifier is used in two collections without an explicit foreign-key or namespace marker.

valid_foreign_key_reuse: 02 and 03 repeat type_id across fields, methods, and vtables as owner references.
16 repeats candidate_id across candidate layouts, patterns, hot offsets, lifecycle, and record patterns.
15 repeats method_id values as scoring-method references rather than entity IDs.

vocabularies.finding: Evidence levels, qualifiers, confidence values, and status values are not normalized across partitions.
evidence: 01 and 08 use a four-level scale: UNKNOWN, INFERRED, SUPPORTED, OBSERVED.
00, 09, and 13 use a seven-level scale; 16 uses a seven-level scale with OBSERVED and CONFIRMED in the opposite order.
07 adds CONFIRMED_NAME_ONLY; 09 uses CONFIRMED_NAME in nested lifecycle records.
02 defines SUPPORTED twice in its Markdown evidence vocabulary and in the JSON policy labels.
12 uses numeric confidence values such as 0.95 and 0.99, while 02, 03, 09, 10, and 15 use low, medium, and high strings.
15 uses low, medium, and high uncertainty alongside its classification vocabulary; these are not interchangeable with evidence levels.

counts.finding: Most structural counts are coherent, but two explicit reconciliation issues remain.

reconciliations.detail: domain_summary assessment_count values sum to 71, matching the 71 assessment records.

C-016 names callsite 0x00B32BC8, while callers_callees lists 0x00C7F109 and omits 0x00B32BC8. The Markdown lists four callsites including both 0x00B32BC8 and 0x00C7F109. Reconcile the claim, ledger, and prose from one canonical callsite list.
required_sections has 24 entries while complete_sections has 23 and omits complete_sections itself.

section_coverage.finding: The worker set uses heterogeneous schemas and does not provide a common section contract. Several partitions combine fields, methods, vtables, lifecycle, consumers, or provenance under topic-specific names, while others omit them by design.
section_coverage.coverage_summary: All partitions have an artifact or scope representation and most have evidence or provenance, but only 01 and 02 expose the complete conventional fields/vtables/inheritance/lifecycle/methods set. Cross-cutting artifacts 12, 14, 15, and 16 are analysis projections rather than full type catalogs.
section_coverage.normalization_action: Add a machine-readable section index or coverage map without forcing every topic artifact to duplicate fields and methods that are out of scope.

isolated_output_compliance.finding: The paired artifacts consistently declare read-only research behavior, no implementation changes, no historical artifact rewrites, and no SPORE mutation. The timestamp policy is not uniform because 08 contains generated_at set to null.
positive_evidence: 03, 07, 11, 14, 15, and 16 explicitly declare deterministic or timestamp-free output policies.
15 records no Ghidra mutation, no implementation changes, no database writes, and no SPORE access.
The audit itself performs no source, binary, Ghidra, database, or SPORE mutation.

findings.finding: All 17 JSON files parse and all matching Markdown files exist.
Two stale exact source paths require correction or explicit historical-alias labeling.
Three identifier namespaces are ambiguous: reused snapshot id, shared resource type id, and cross-collection assessment/unlocker id.
Evidence scales, qualifiers, confidence representations, and status vocabularies are inconsistent.
Persistence callsite enumeration disagrees across JSON claim, JSON ledger, and Markdown; 16 omits complete_sections from its own completed-section list.
Ordering is stable per artifact but not governed by one documented cross-artifact policy; several scalar arrays are narrative or source-group ordered.
Section names and granularity are heterogeneous, preventing a simple completeness comparison without a common section index.
generated_at is present as null; use an omitted-field policy consistently while retaining semantic timestamp claims in content descriptions.

The 0x00B321340 message-registration label is preserved as a historical claim, while current artifacts consistently use 0x00B21340 for the map/list bridge. Preserve the alias, but do not silently rewrite historical evidence.
Assessment and domain-summary counts reconcile exactly at 71; this is a passing integrity check.

normalization_requirements.requirement: Adopt one canonical evidence scale, preferably UNKNOWN < APPROXIMATION < INFERRED < SUPPORTED < OBSERVED < CONFIRMED < VERIFIED, and represent name-only or structural-only limitations as separate qualifiers.
Choose one canonical confidence representation. Preserve raw numeric confidence only in a field such as confidence_numeric and expose a separately defined confidence_band or confidence_basis.
Remove generated_at from all research artifacts and use an explicit timestamp_policy value such as omitted; do not use a null wall-clock field.
Separate source path from source locator. Replace stale exact paths, and split compound aliases such as file.hpp/.cpp into path and locator fields.
Separate record identity from resource type identity. Use a unique record_id alongside resource_type_id, and give cross-collection references an explicit namespace or foreign_key marker.
Add a common section index or coverage map describing present, combined, omitted, and out-of-scope sections for every artifact.
Generate declared counts from canonical record arrays. Reconcile 08 callsite claims and make 16 required_sections and complete_sections derive from the same section inventory.
Define one serialization policy: lexical top-level keys and lexical scalar arrays, or explicitly declared authored order recorded in the artifact metadata.
Preserve historical address labels as aliases. Canonical current references should use 0x00B21340; do not silently replace the historical 0x00B321340 claim.
Keep semantic timestamps such as event-record timestamp fields separate from artifact-generation metadata and name them consistently in normalization.

conclusion.summary: The 17 worker artifacts are complete as parseable JSON/Markdown pairs and consistently preserve static-only, clean-room research boundaries. They are not yet a single normalized corpus: stale references, ambiguous identifiers, mixed vocabularies, two count mismatches, and heterogeneous section/order policies should be resolved before synthesis or automated ingestion.
